title: The Regiment of the Lower Danube
author: Mara Crane
blurb: Beatrix Iversen, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
